程序包 org.bukkit

接口 UnsafeValues

@Deprecated(since="1.7.2") public interface UnsafeValues
已过时。
这个接口提供可能在特定运行时间内或含有任意意义的数值的转换（即不安全的参数）.

这些值的存在形式和行为不能保证在未来的版本可用。可能会非法命名，抛出异常，有误导参数或其他错误.

原文： This interface provides value conversions that may be specific to a runtime, or have arbitrary meaning (read: magic values).

Their existence and behavior is not guaranteed across future versions. They may be poorly named, throw exceptions, have misleading parameters, or any other bad programming practice.

    • loadAdvancement

      Advancement loadAdvancement(NamespacedKey key, java.lang.String advancement)
      已过时。
      将指定字符串表示的进度加载到服务器中。 进度格式由 Minecraft 控制，没有指定的布局。
      目前是一个 JSON 对象，如 Minecraft wiki 所述。
      加载的进度将被存储并在服务器重启和重载后持续存在。
      调用者应准备好捕获 Exception。

      原文： Load an advancement represented by the specified string into the server. The advancement format is governed by Minecraft and has no specified layout.
      It is currently a JSON object, as described by the Minecraft wiki.
      Loaded advancements will be stored and persisted across server restarts and reloads.
      Callers should be prepared for Exception to be thrown.

      参数:
      key - 进度的唯一键

      原文：the unique advancement key

      advancement - 进度的表示形式

      原文：representation of the advancement

      返回:
      加载的进度，如果发生错误则返回 null

      原文：Load an advancement represented by the specified string into the server. The advancement format is governed by Minecraft and has no specified layout.
      It is currently a JSON object, as described by the Minecraft wiki.
      Loaded advancements will be stored and persisted across server restarts and reloads.
      Callers should be prepared for Exception to be thrown.

      原文：the loaded advancement or null if an error occurred

    • removeAdvancement

      boolean removeAdvancement(NamespacedKey key)
      已过时。
      删除由 loadAdvancement(org.bukkit.NamespacedKey, java.lang.String) 加载并保存的进度。
      此方法只会从持久存储中删除进度。应该伴随调用 Server.reloadData() 以便从运行实例中完全删除它。

      原文： Delete an advancement which was loaded and saved by loadAdvancement(org.bukkit.NamespacedKey, java.lang.String).
      This method will only remove advancement from persistent storage. It should be accompanied by a call to Server.reloadData() in order to fully remove it from the running instance.

      参数:
      key - 进度的唯一键

      原文：the unique advancement key

      返回:
      如果找到并删除了匹配此键的文件则返回 true

      原文：Delete an advancement which was loaded and saved by loadAdvancement(org.bukkit.NamespacedKey, java.lang.String).
      This method will only remove advancement from persistent storage. It should be accompanied by a call to Server.reloadData() in order to fully remove it from the running instance.

      原文：true if a file matching this key was found and deleted

    • serializeItemAsJson

      @NotNull com.google.gson.JsonObject serializeItemAsJson(@NotNull @NotNull ItemStack itemStack)
      已过时。
      Serializes this itemstack to json format. It is safe for data migrations as it will use the built-in data converter instead of bukkit's dangerous serialization system.

      The emitted json object's format will inherently change across versions and hence should not be used for non-development purposes like plugin configurations or end-user input.

      返回:
      json object representing this item.
      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the passed itemstack is ItemStack.empty().
      另请参阅:
      • deserializeItemFromJson(com.google.gson.JsonObject)

    • deserializeItemFromJson

      @NotNull @NotNull ItemStack deserializeItemFromJson(@NotNull com.google.gson.JsonObject data) throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
      已过时。
      Creates an itemstack from a json object.

      This method expects a json object in the format emitted by serializeItemAsJson(ItemStack).

      The emitted json object's format will inherently change across versions and hence should not be used for non-development purposes like plugin configurations or end-user input.

      参数:
      data - object representing an item in Json format
      返回:
      the deserialize item stack, migrated to the latest data version if needed.
      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the json object is not a valid item
      另请参阅:
      • serializeItemAsJson(ItemStack)

      accessor - The RegionAccessor of the provided coordinates

      y - Y-coordinate of the block
      z - Z-coordinate of the block
      biomeKey - Biome key
      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalStateException - if no biome by the given key is registered.
